desc: Created by Shadow Systems with John Lovell’s hand-selected features, the War Poet line of pistols merges Warrior Poet Society’s philosophy with Shadow Systems functionality. War Poet pistols are built on the CR920 platform, with all internal features of those pistols alongside exclusive WPS color and brand elements. The differentiating features of the War Poet line are in the slide machining. John Lovell selected agressively angled serrations in front, rear, and topside, paired with a weight-balancing window cut. All War Poet models come standard with the patented Shadow Systems multi-footprint optic cut, allowing for direct, strong mounting of most brands of red dot sights.
